scientific.integrity: The stabilizer bound is proved from the unique conic, the unique secant line, and the induced Möbius action on four marked conic points. Exact symbolic replay checks the component intersections and all four realized projective maps.
scientific.limitations: The statement concerns only the displayed complex one-conic five-line arrangement and does not classify all arrangements with the same weak singularity data.

title: Projective stabilizer of Czarnota's Configuration B
